items.description: Scoopmap.net allows users to view breaking news around the world by leveraging two APIs. Discover hot spots and articles written by high quality newspapers such as the Guardian and New York Times.

For each of the 1.95 million DBpedia concepts, the wrappr generates a collection of flickr photos that depict the concept, utilizing multilingual labels and geo-coordinates provided in Wikipedia entries.

A map of contributions to 2006 Massachusetts gubernatorial campaigns. Uses the Google Maps API and data from the Massachusetts Office of Campaign and Political finance. One of the most extensive use of data with layering on Google Maps.
Crowdsourcing happy hour specials in NYC with SMS and Twitter.
Real-time HTML/CSS/Javascript editor and advanced Search Engine dedicated to web development and design.
A numerical ranking based on popularity of country music artists.

A widget that uses Zazzle's Store Builder API to create a custom display of a contributor's most popular or most recently created Zazzle products. Display results from a single Zazzle gallery, a single product line, or the entire Zazzle marketpl

CallCollector is a virtual voicemail box to collect calls from fans, customers, groups, or whatever you need it for. A business may use it as a complaint & feedback line. A talk radio station may use it to allow listeners to vent to (or about) their on-air personalities. You might even use it to collect wishes from family all over the county and stitch them together for a relative's birthday or anniversary.
